title: What is new in Waypoint
caption: Part 5: the newest updates in Waypoint. Mira shows what is new.
linkedin_text: Part 5 of the Waypoint tour, the recent updates: eight feelings on every post, three posts to react to when you join, private replies, saying thanks, seen counts and a welcome for first posts, quiet check-ins, the Calm kit, Quick exit, official messages on the Wall, Listening Night and appeals for removed accounts.

scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. Part five: what is new in Waypoint.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. Part five: what is new in Waypoint.

scenes.vo: Every post now carries one of eight feelings, from frustrated to grateful.
scenes.sub: Every post now carries one of eight feelings, from frustrated to grateful.

scenes.vo: New here? See three recent posts, and react with one tap.
scenes.sub: New here? See three recent posts, and react with one tap.

scenes.vo: Reply privately: one message that only the post's author sees.
scenes.sub: Reply privately: one message that only the post's author sees.

scenes.vo: Say thanks to everyone who reacted, quietly, with no names.
scenes.sub: Say thanks to everyone who reacted, quietly, with no names.

scenes.vo: A first post nobody has reacted to yet gets a welcome from Waypoint.
scenes.sub: A first post nobody has reacted to yet gets a welcome from Waypoint.

scenes.vo: After you post, a quiet check-in asks: lighter, same or heavier?
scenes.sub: After you post, a quiet check-in asks: lighter, same or heavier?

scenes.vo: The Calm kit: breathe, ground yourself, or wind down.
scenes.sub: The Calm kit: breathe, ground yourself, or wind down.

scenes.vo: Turn on Quick exit, for a one-tap way out of the app.
scenes.sub: Turn on Quick exit, for a one-tap way out of the app.

scenes.vo: Official messages from Waypoint rotate at the top of the Wall.
scenes.sub: Official messages from Waypoint rotate at the top of the Wall.

scenes.vo: Save a seat for a weekly Listening Night, when one is scheduled.
scenes.sub: Save a seat for a weekly Listening Night, when one is scheduled.

scenes.vo: A removed account sees why, and can send an appeal.
scenes.sub: A removed account sees why, and can send an appeal.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play, in many Indian and international languages.
